name: dodojo-skills
description: Open agent skills from dodojo: dodojo-travel, trip pages checked for your dates with a map and real photos, and five game skills for board games, party games, puzzles, arcade games and story games you play on one page.

plugins.name: dodojo-skills
plugins.description: dodojo-travel: plan a trip or a day out as a phone-first page with checked hours and tickets, a map of each day and real photos. Game skills: dodojo-game (board and card games with a computer opponent), dodojo-party-game (a group around one phone), dodojo-puzzle-game (puzzles proven by a solver), dodojo-arcade-game (one-thumb action) and dodojo-story-game (branching stories, mysteries, escape rooms). All save into dodojo or stand on their own.
